title: aidd languages
description: The format of schemas/languages.json: what aidd knows about each language. Supporting another language is a row and no code.

languages.description: One row for each language, keyed by a lower-case id, in alphabetical order.

manifests_of_any_language.description: Manifests that name a project in any language, such as a Makefile that holds its test target. A manifest in a language row is not listed here.

manifest.description: A manifest's file name, with no folder. `aidd init` opens a file of this name and no other.

extensions.description: The extensions of its source files, each with the dot and in lower case. A file that ends with one is source code. The first is the usual one, where a test writes one file of the language, and the rest follow in alphabetical order.

manifests.description: The manifests that name a project in it, in alphabetical order. One file name belongs to one language.
